messages:
elaine_cs: Quick weekly pulse for Saturn onboarding — top-line numbers below, pls chime in:
- GPU hours: 1,240 (↑18% w/w)
- Avg GPU saturation: 78% (peak 94% during spike)
- Queue depth: avg 6, peaked 22 at ~03:40 UTC
- P95 latency: 480ms (last week 420ms)
- Error rate: 0.7% (last week 0.2%), mostly OOMs
- Spend (hosted/dedicated mix): ~$12.6k this week
Any immediate concerns or quick mitigation ideas? :eyes:

tariq_infra: Saw the overnight spike — correlates with a long eval job from Saturn's team. I can see node restarts around 03:37 UTC, and a few OOM traces in the worker logs.
Log excerpt:
```
worker-23 | OOM while allocating 6.2GiB
worker-23 | restart triggered by liveness-check
```
I suspect long-context runs prevented efficient batching, pushing queue depth. I'll dig into which tenant job IDs later.

marta_cs: I already pinged the Saturn PM — they confirmed a handful of evaluation runs on larger contexts. Renewal still green but they'll likely ask about cost optimization. Suggest we offer a short enablement session focused on batching + KV cache tips.

tariq_infra: Action item: I'll temporarily increase burst capacity by +2 GPU workers for 48h and tighten the autoscaler policy to favor short jobs in the scheduler (policy ref: `pref-short-job-v3`). Monitoring alert set. I'll update when burst is active.

elaine_cs: Thanks — please post when burst is up. I'll schedule the enablement walkthrough for Saturn SRE/ML on Tue 11am PT (Marta to lead). Also recommend a proposed one-off burst credit offer to offset this week's overage; Marta, can you draft?

ops-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: node-restart-group-4 cleared (runbook executed: restart-worker v2). No further restarts in last 15m.

marta_cs: Drafted the burst credit email, will share in #customer-success-drafts. Next steps summary:
1) Confirm burst + autoscaler change (tariq)
2) Send enablement invite + prep notes (elaine, marta)
3) Offer 1-week burst credit & cost-optimization tips (marta)
4) Re-check account health in one week; pre-renewal touchpoint in 2 weeks (head-cs)

elaine_cs: +1. If we still see sustained saturation after the burst window, recommend a short-term reserved uplift conversation with sales (we should pre-approve ballpark numbers to speed that path).

tariq_infra: Burst live now, added a dashboard panel for Saturn: `saturn/pool1/queue-depth` and alert at queue_depth > 15 for 10m. I'll watch and report by EOD.

elaine_cs: Perfect — thanks all. Will capture this thread in the weekly handoff doc.
